items.q: What does Priya need to do before the committee meeting on Thursday 18 March?
items.answer: Book the skip for the clear-out (the permit has come through), finish sending round the AGM minutes (the draft is done), and draft the open day leaflet.

items.q: Is anything waiting on the council? If so, what?
items.answer: No—nothing shown is explicitly waiting on the council. Four tasks are marked “Waiting”: water meter replacement, public liability insurance renewal, main gate lock repair, and shed roof felt replacement, but none names the council.
